structure.unit: Provisions Applicable to Probate and Nonprobate Transfers

law.catch_line: Admissibility of judicial record determining slayer
law.text: The record of the judicial proceeding in which a person is determined to be a slayer shall be admissible in evidence for or against a claimant of property in any civil action arising under this chapter. A conviction shall be conclusive evidence of the guilt of the slayer.
